# DonorDock vs Network for Good Comparison

## **DonorDock**

### Best For
- Small to mid-sized nonprofits
- Organizations wanting simple, affordable donor management
- Nonprofits needing basic CRM functionality

### Key Features
- Donor database management
- Online donation forms
- Email marketing
- Task management
- Donation tracking and receipting
- Basic reporting

### Pricing
- Starts around $39-99/month depending on plan
- More affordable for smaller organizations
- Transparent pricing structure

### Pros
- User-friendly interface
- Good customer support
- Affordable for smaller budgets
- Easy to set up and use

### Cons
- Fewer advanced features
- Limited customization options
- Smaller ecosystem/integrations

---

## **Network for Good**

### Best For
- Small to medium nonprofits
- Organizations wanting all-in-one fundraising platform
- Nonprofits needing more robust coaching/support

### Key Features
- Donor management (CRM)
- Online fundraising tools
- Peer-to-peer fundraising
- Email marketing
- Donation processing
- Fundraising coaching and support
- More comprehensive reporting

### Pricing
- Platform fees starting around $99-249+/month
- Plus payment processing fees
- Can be more expensive overall

### Pros
- More comprehensive feature set
- Includes fundraising coaching/resources
- Established platform with good reputation
- Strong email marketing tools
- Better for growing organizations

### Cons
- Higher cost
- Can be overkill for very small organizations
- Steeper learning curve

---

## **Which Should You Choose?**

**Choose DonorDock if:**
- You have a limited budget
- You need simple donor tracking
- You're a smaller organization (<1,000 donors)

**Choose Network for Good if:**
- You need more robust fundraising tools
- You want coaching/training included
- You're planning to scale
- You need advanced email marketing

Both are solid options—your choice depends mainly on budget, organizational size, and feature needs.
